usage_contract.source_content_retained: material announcement titles, identifiers and compact discovery metadata only
usage_contract.authorization_basis: The user explicitly authorized personal use and storage where the source does not state that storage is prohibited.
stop_conditions: an explicit source prohibition is discovered
authentication or access-control bypass would be required
the 1.75 GiB project hard cap would be exceeded
repeated source errors indicate rate limiting or service harm

cninfo_acquisition.request_interval_scope: every real HTTP GET and POST, including pagination
cninfo_acquisition.historical_universe_rule: main-board code plus at least one PIT raw close above zero and at or below 200 CNY; current static name, board or risk status is not backfilled
cninfo_acquisition.known_limit: Historical ST and delisting status remains unverified and must not be inferred from the current stock profile.

explicit_exclusions: telecom fraud, crime and weapons stories
gdelt_acquisition.permitted_use: candidate discovery and source-channel diagnostics only

storage_contract.hard_cap_scope: entire acquisition artifact root including checkpoints, Raw, Silver, PIT and manifests

strategy_boundary.reason: The official-fact full-window dataset has started but is incomplete, and no professional-news primary source has passed the relevance, timestamp and revision gates.
